violations.text: The access aisle serving the accessible parking space measures 48 inches in width; a minimum of 60 inches is required.

correctives.text: Restripe the access aisle to a minimum width of 60 inches adjacent to the accessible parking space.

violations.text: Side grab bar measures 30 inches in length; a minimum of 42 inches is required.

correctives.text: Install a side grab bar a minimum of 42 inches long, mounted 33 to 36 inches above the finish floor to the centerline.

violations.text: THIS SHOULD BE SUPPRESSED: book drop slot at 52 inches.
